name: gold-tracker
description: Track gold purchases against the live INR price

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format
